title: An advanced hybrid-dimensional Stokes-Darcy model for fractured porous media
summary: Thin fluid-filled channels in porous media are prevalent in a wide range of environmental settings including fractures in geological formations. Transport of fluid in such multi-domain systems is commonly described by Darcy's law and formulated either in a fully dimensional framework or through a hybrid-dimensional approach, where fractures are represented as inclusions of co-dimension one enclosed in the porous matrix.
